best_parts: node o2b: one explanation that lists the three wall classes with an example for each, placed after the wrong-answer feedback and before the re-test p5
node f1 and f2: name the tempting model, give the refutation, then the key, with a sure_note for the confident error (hypercorrection)
node hook / hint1: three traps, each tagged, and a hint that names the setting words without giving the answer
flaws: node v1 and v1r: key 'Obstructed hernia; check every orifice' is the longest option and the only one with a clause, so the key is findable by form (DP1); the trap-map requires comparable options
node hook2: the identical stem is re-asked straight after feedback that names the answer's setting, so the retry is cued and tests recall of the last reply, not the idea

nodes o2a and p5: a wrong pick goes straight to explanation with no hint and no retry, and the re-test p5 uses the same which-class form, so TR40 is not re-tested in a different form within the segment

best_parts: node hint_c: asks what the history rules out and which part to examine next, a hint that points at the mechanism without naming the answer
node wall (intussusception feedback t_intus): 'the bowel telescopes within its own wall, so it is intramural' refutes the trap by its mechanism
node vg with its hint ladder (hint_c, then show-me) gives a full retry path for the virgin-abdomen trap
flaws: node vg: the two distractors 'Adhesions from an old operation' and 'Adhesive bands from earlier surgery' are the same trap (TR2) and near-synonyms, so one is redundant and the key is the only non-adhesion option, which is findable by form (DP1, DP2)
nodes t_adh, t_carc, t_rev, t_virgin: feedback on a wrong pick uses 'Right:' as a label for the correct model, which blurs what the learner should keep
node ext: the class-by-wall re-test repeats the S1 class form and gives no new case, so the wall trap gets no real variation inside the segment

best_parts: node both: the single-answer trap 'PYQ key: adhesions; current practice: adhesions' is a distinct wrong model, and expl_same names that model (one answer for two columns)
node ok_both with the 'I know the wall sort, skip it' fast lane to which: an expertise-reversal path that still probes O2 on the NOT question
node which: a NOT-form probe whose wrong options (intussusception, carcinoma) each carry a refutation that ties to the wall class (K20, K22)
flaws: node virgin: no hint and no retry after a miss, and the probe goes straight to a short explanation; the trap is not given a first-miss second chance (pedagogy section 3)
nodes sort and which: wrong picks lead to explanation with no retry, so the wall logic is not re-tested after feedback in the same segment
node both: no 'Not sure' help option, unlike the other PYQ probes, so a learner who is guessing has no hint step before the explanation

merge_ideas: c's skip lane and single-answer trap in 'both' with b's hint ladder (hint then show-me) and b's wall-telescope refutation for the intussusception trap
a's o2b list-after-miss explanation and sure_note structure, with c's retry on the virgin and sort probes so every miss gets a hint and a retry

a's v1 probe with length-matched options (no 'check every orifice' clause on the key), and b's vg with one of its two adhesion distractors replaced by a different TR2 model, for example a reversed history cue
